item.title: Mankatha Re-Release Opening Day Box Office: Ajith Kumar's film overtakes Ghilli, grosses Rs 3.75 crore in Tamil Nadu
item.description: Ajith Kumar's Mankatha stormed a solid opening in its re-release today. As per estimates, the action thriller took a banger start of Rs. 3.75 crore at the Tamil Nadu box office, recording the biggest opening for a re-release movie. The movie wrote history by overtaking Thalapathy Vijay's Ghilli on its Day 1. item.title: Dhurandhar Box Office Collections: Ranveer Singh starrer nets Rs 779 crore in 50 days, records drop with Border 2's release
item.description: Ranveer Singh's spy action drama Dhurandhar completed its 50 days of theatrical run at the box office. After wrapping its 7th week on a record figure, the movie entered the 8th week by registering a big drop. As per estimates, Dhurandhar collected Rs. 50 lakh on its Day 50 (8th Friday), recording a drop of roughly 40 percent.
